Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 63 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An attacker wanting 165 effective identities must lock that capital for 63 epochs and keep it locked through every basalt audit. That is 30 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
